title: Camp Canaan

services.name: Zipline
services.desc: The Canaan Zipline Canopy Tour takes you through an elaborate network of cables and platforms high in the treetops and across the Catawba River! It’s a sky-high adventure that’s great for groups of all sizes - from families and corporate groups to youth and school groups. Designed for guests who are in reasonably good health, our Zipline Canopy Tour can be enjoyed over the course of 2.5 to 4+ hours. No experience necessary. Experience an exhilarating adventure featuring all nine zips. Fly over the forest floor, criss cross the river, and end with a 900 foot zip reaching speeds of 35 mph! 2.5-3 hours (large groups 4+ hours) Weight: min 75 lbs, max 265 lbs Group size: 10-60 Season:

explain.meaning: A course of ziplines strung between trees or towers.

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Camp Canaan serves young people ages 5 to 16 from the Charlotte, Fort Mill, and Rock Hill area with daytime and overnight camp experiences of the highest caliber. We annually offer nine consecutive weeks of action-packed summer camps, a fun and festive winter camp, and a backpacking trip in the spring. The adventure never stops! Everything you need at your fingertips! Bookmark this page for quick access to camp dates and rates, frequently asked camp questions, this summer’s camp handbook, day and overnight camp packing lists, and scholarship information.
